item.title: Important Message From the Federation of Hellenic American Societies
item.description: The celebration of “OXI” Day that will take place on Sunday, October 30, 2022 at the Maliotis Center and your presence along with friends and relatives is requested.The 2nd attachment is a notice with the agenda for the upcoming General Assembly of our Federation that will take place on November 16, 2022 at 7:00pm at the Maliotis Center. Representatives from all societies must be present and participate. According to our by-laws the message must go out one month prior to the General Assembly.
